motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.purpose: User reduced-motion preference shortens existing animation and transition durations.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Existing default action button used by sign-in and run controls.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:8px; font-family:var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-button:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:0.5; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--ring); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition-duration:0.01ms; } } .ds-primary { border:1px solid transparent; background:var(--primary); color:var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary) 90%,transparent); }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Existing outlined button for manual monitor runs.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:8px; font-family:var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-button:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:0.5; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--ring); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition-duration:0.01ms; } } .ds-outline { border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--background); color:var(--foreground); box-shadow:0 1px 2px #0000000d; } .ds-outline:hover { background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-foreground); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-outline { border-color:var(--input); background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--input) 30%,transparent); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-outline:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--input) 50%,transparent); }

components.name: Ghost button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:8px; font-family:var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-button:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:0.5; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--ring); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition-duration:0.01ms; } } .ds-ghost { border:1px solid transparent; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground); } .ds-ghost:hover { background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-foreground); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-ghost:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 50%,transparent); }

components.name: Shell control
components.description: Compact outlined shell action with a minimum 32px target.
components.css: .ds-control { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; min-height:32px; min-width:32px; padding:5px 10px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:7px; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground); font:500 12px var(--font-sans, sans-serif); cursor:pointer; } .ds-control:hover:not(:disabled), .ds-control[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--accent); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Monitor search
components.description: Search field with its inline search icon and accessible name.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input type="search" aria-label="Search monitors" placeholder="Search monitors"/></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display:block; position:relative; min-width:180px; } .ds-search svg { position:absolute; top:50%; left:11px; width:15px; height:15px; transform:translateY(-50%); color:var(--muted-foreground); pointer-events:none; } .ds-search input { width:100%; height:34px; padding:6px 10px 6px 34px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:7px; background:var(--card); color:var(--foreground); font:13px var(--font-sans, sans-serif); caret-color:var(--status-up); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--faint); opacity:1; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Operator navigation
components.description: Current-route links with a filled selected surface.
components.html: OverviewMonitorsAlerts
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; min-width:0; overflow-x:auto; } .ds-nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; min-height:32px; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:6px; color:var(--muted-foreground); font:13px var(--font-sans, sans-serif); text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { background:var(--accent); color:var(--foreground); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:3px; } @media(max-width:640px) { .ds-nav a { font-size:12px; padding-inline:8px; } }

components.name: Status pill
components.description: Text-labeled service state with a matching dot and tinted surface.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:5px; color:var(--status-pending); background:var(--status-pending-bg); font:500 12px/1.5 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-dot { display:inline-block; flex-shrink:0; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; } .ds-pill[data-status="up"] { color:var(--status-up); background:var(--status-up-bg); } .ds-pill[data-status="down"] { color:var(--status-down); background:var(--status-down-bg); } .ds-pill[data-status="degraded"] { color:var(--status-degraded); background:var(--status-degraded-bg); } .ds-pill[data-status="pending"] { color:var(--status-pending); background:var(--status-pending-bg); } .ds-pill[data-status="scheduled"] { color:var(--status-scheduled); background:var(--status-scheduled-bg); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Uniformly bordered surface for actual page content.
components.css: .ds-panel { position:relative; min-width:0; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; background:var(--card); color:var(--foreground); font:14px/1.5 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); } .ds-panel-copy { padding:16px; }

components.name: Metric strip
components.description: Aligned numeric measurements with supporting labels.
components.css: .ds-metrics { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(140px,100%),1fr)); margin:0; border-block:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--foreground); } .ds-metrics > div { min-width:0; padding:16px; } .ds-metrics > div + div { border-left:1px solid var(--border); } .ds-metrics > div:first-child { padding-left:0; } .ds-metric-label { color:var(--muted-foreground); font:12px var(--font-sans, sans-serif); } .ds-metric-value { margin:5px 0 0; font:500 25px/1.3 var(--font-mono, monospace); letter-spacing:-0.035em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Performance disclosure
components.description: Native details disclosure keeps performance content available below status.
components.css: .ds-performance { border-top:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--foreground); font-family:var(--font-sans, sans-serif); } .ds-performance > summary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; padding-block:15px; list-style:none; font-size:15px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-performance > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; } .ds-performance > summary > span { color:var(--muted-foreground); font-size:12px; font-weight:400; } .ds-performance > summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-chart-surface { min-width:0; padding:16px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; background:var(--card); font-size:13px; }

narrative.overview:
Pongo uses compact neutral surfaces, system sans text and explicit service states. The same shell aligns operator pages, public status pages and authentication screens. Color identifies status or interaction; spacing and borders establish hierarchy.

The implemented direction comes from the user-approved mockups and the denser full-site brief. Configuration, live measurements and existing actions remain the content of the interface.
keyCharacteristics: One content width across header, main and footer.
Compact rows with readable supporting labels.
Green, amber, red and neutral service states with text labels.
Dark and light themes share the same structure.

rules.name: The Status Meaning Rule
rules.body: A state color accompanies a state label. Unknown or paused service data retains its stated meaning rather than implying success or failure.

rules.name: The Shared Width Rule
rules.body: Header, main, public tabs and footer retain the same left edge and width on every route; page primitives do not add narrower containers.

dos: Do align every route to the shared shell, including public and authentication pages.
Do keep code and measurements in monospace and prose in system sans.
Do pair status colors with state text and preserve unknown measurements.
Do retain keyboard inspection, focus visibility and recovery controls in zen mode.
donts: Don't add decorative rails, dotted backgrounds, status glows or halo effects.
Don't turn missing results into healthy uptime or zero latency.
Don't add nested width containers that narrow individual pages.
Don't reduce all text globally when density changes.
